name: Harley-Davidson Rocker / Rocker C
engine: 96 cubic inch Twin Cam B V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive, 240 rear tire
intro: Harley's long chopper-style Softail. A wide rear tire, a fender that moves with the swingarm and the 96 engine.

E: Twin Cam engines from these years use spring-loaded cam chain tensioners with plastic shoes. Check the shoes for wear before you trust the engine.

recallNote: Harley-Davidson has issued several recalls that touch these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
